# NFL Football 4 schedule, format 1.
# The 272 games of one real regular season: 18 weeks, 17 games for each team and one bye week. The game plays this schedule in a franchise's first season.
# Each line is an ID, an equals sign, the visiting team's ID, the home team's ID and the date of the game. The IDs of the teams are the ones of teams.txt, T01 to T32.
# W07G03 is the third game of week 7. A team that has no line in a week has its bye that week. The names are facts, used descriptively.
# A new season: replace the lines, change the VERSION line and keep the 18 weeks. The game checks the file and plays the original's random 16 weeks when it is not whole.
# The teams in the order of their IDs: T01 CIN, T02 CLE, T03 BAL, T04 PIT, T05 BUF, T06 MIA, T07 NYJ, T08 NE, T09 DEN, T10 LAC, T11 KC, T12 LV, T13 IND, T14 JAX, T15 HOU, T16 TEN, T17 CHI, T18 DET, T19 GB, T20 MIN, T21 DAL, T22 PHI, T23 NYG, T24 WAS, T25 ARI, T26 SF, T27 LA, T28 SEA, T29 TB, T30 ATL, T31 CAR, T32 NO.

VERSION = season 2026, as of 2026-10-22, from the public nflverse schedule table
